name: FirstUK Bank Privacy Policy
description: The governing instrument for privacy and data protection at FirstUK Bank, version 2.1, effective from 2026-01-15. It is owned by the Data Protection Officer and applies to all staff and customers.

name: General Data Protection Regulation
description: The European Union regulation (2016/679) that serves as a regulatory basis for the FirstUK Bank Privacy Policy.

name: Data Protection Act 2018
description: The UK legislation that serves as a regulatory basis for the FirstUK Bank Privacy Policy.
context: Regulatory Reference | GDPR (EU 2016/679), Data Protection Act 2018

description: The abstract role designated as the owner of the Privacy Policy, responsible for its governance and oversight.

name: All Staff
description: The collective of all bank employees who are identified as the target audience and subject to the requirements of the Privacy Policy.

name: Customers
description: The bank's customers who are identified as the target audience and subjects of the privacy protections outlined in the policy.

context: FirstUK Bank is committed to protecting customer personal data
This policy establishes procedures for data collection, processing, storage, and customer rights management.

name: General Data Protection Regulation

name: UK Data Protection Act 2018

context: in compliance with... UK Data Protection Act 2018

name: Bank Customer
description: The individual whose personal data is subject to protection and who possesses specific rights managed under this policy.

name: Data Collection Procedure Requirement
description: The requirement to adhere to established procedures when collecting personal data from customers.

name: Data Processing Procedure Requirement
description: The requirement to adhere to established procedures when processing customer personal data.

name: Data Storage Procedure Requirement
description: The requirement to adhere to established procedures for the secure storage of customer personal data.

name: Customer Rights Management Requirement

name: Personal Data Protection Policy
description: A formal policy establishing procedures for the protection of personal data. It aims to ensure compliance with data protection laws, respect customer privacy, and secure data against unauthorized access.
context: To establish procedures for personal data protection

name: General Data Protection Regulation
description: An external regulation that the bank's personal data protection procedures must comply with.

name: UK Data Protection Act
description: National legislation governing data protection in the UK which the bank is mandated to follow.
context: Comply with GDPR and UK Data Protection Act

name: Unauthorized Access
description: The risk of personal data being accessed by individuals or systems without proper authorization.
context: Secure personal data against unauthorized access

name: Compliance with Data Protection Legislation
description: A requirement that all personal data protection procedures must be in compliance with the GDPR and the UK Data Protection Act.
context: Comply with GDPR and UK Data Protection Act

name: Respect for Customer Privacy Rights
description: An obligation to ensure that the bank's procedures respect the privacy rights of its customers.

name: Securing Personal Data
description: A mandate to implement security measures that protect personal data from unauthorized access.
context: Secure personal data against unauthorized access

name: Management of Subject Access Requests
description: A requirement to establish and manage a process for handling customer subject access requests.

name: Implementation of Data Subject Rights
description: A requirement to implement the specific rights of data subjects, including the rights to access, erasure, and portability.
context: Implement data subject rights (access, erasure, portability)

name: Data Subject
description: The individual to whom personal data relates, who possesses specific rights such as access, erasure, and portability.
context: Implement data subject rights (access, erasure, portability)

name: Customer
description: Bank customers whose privacy rights must be respected and who may submit subject access requests.

name: Data Privacy Policy
description: A governing policy document defining the scope of protection for customer personal data, applicable to all staff, contractors, and data processing activities across all systems and storage.
context: Applies to: All customer personal data

name: All Staff and Contractors
description: The collective group of employees and external contractors to whom the data privacy policy requirements apply.
context: Applies to: All staff and contractors

name: Customer Personal Data Exposure
description: The risk associated with the handling and processing of customer personal data, which is the primary subject of the policy's scope.
context: Applies to: All customer personal data

name: FirstUK Bank Data Processing Policy
description: The governing policy statement regarding the processing of customer personal data at FirstUK Bank. It establishes the bank's stance that data processing must be necessary for banking services and accompanied by safeguards and customer control.
context: FirstUK Bank processes customer personal data only where necessary for banking services, with proper safeguards and customer control.

name: Necessity Requirement for Personal Data Processing
description: A mandate requiring that the processing of customer personal data be limited strictly to instances where such processing is necessary for the provision of banking services.
context: FirstUK Bank processes customer personal data only where necessary for banking services

name: Requirement for Data Safeguards and Customer Control
description: A requirement that all processing of customer personal data must be implemented with appropriate safeguards and ensure that customers maintain control over their data.
context: with proper safeguards and customer control

name: Customer
description: The individual whose personal data is processed by the bank and who is granted control over said data under the policy statement.

name: Data Safeguards
description: The general operational safeguards required by the policy to protect customer personal data during processing.

name: FirstUK Bank Data Privacy Policy
description: A formal policy governing the lawful processing, security, and retention of data, as well as the management of customer privacy rights and consent.

name: Lawful Basis for Data Processing
description: A mandate ensuring that data is processed exclusively for banking or regulatory purposes.
context: Data processed only for banking/regulatory purposes

name: Transparency and Privacy Notification
description: An obligation to provide customers with clear and transparent privacy notices.
context: Clear privacy notices provided to customers

name: Data Security Standards
description: A requirement to implement security measures, specifically encryption and access controls, to protect data.
context: Data Security: Encryption and access controls

name: Subject Access Request Response Timeframe
description: A mandatory requirement that customer subject access requests must be processed within a 30-day window.
context: Subject access requests processed within 30 days

name: Data Retention Limitation
description: A rule stating that data must only be retained for the duration that it is deemed necessary.
context: Data retained only as long as necessary

name: Marketing Consent Management
description: A requirement that explicit consent must be obtained before using data for marketing communications.

name: Data Encryption
description: A technical safeguard used to ensure data security as mandated by the policy.

name: Access Controls
description: Operational mechanisms used to restrict data access and ensure security.

name: Customers
description: The individuals to whom privacy notices are provided and who hold the right to submit subject access requests.
context: Clear privacy notices provided to customers
Subject access requests processed within 30 days

name: Bank Customer
description: The subject of privacy protections, including the right to transparency and data access.
context: Clear privacy notices provided to customers

name: FirstUK Bank Data Processing and Retention Policy
description: A policy governing the lawful bases for data processing and the specific retention periods for various banking activities at FirstUK Bank.
context: Lawful Bases Used by FirstUK Bank

name: Data Retention for Account Opening and Management
description: Mandates that data processed for account opening and management under contractual necessity must be retained for the duration of the account tenure plus an additional 6 years.
context: Account opening & management | Contractual necessity | Account tenure + 6 years

name: Data Retention for KYC and AML Compliance
description: Requires that data processed for KYC/AML compliance under legal obligation be retained for a period of 5 to 6 years following the closure of the account.
context: KYC/AML compliance | Legal obligation | 5-6 years post-closure

name: Data Retention for Fraud Detection
description: Specifies that data processed for fraud detection based on legitimate interest must be retained for 3 years.

name: Data Retention for Marketing
description: States that data processed for marketing purposes based on explicit consent is retained until such consent is withdrawn.
context: Marketing (if consented) | Explicit consent | Until withdrawal

name: Data Retention for Regulatory Reporting
description: Mandates that data for regulatory reporting be retained according to the specific regulation, typically between 5 and 7 years.
context: Regulatory reporting | Legal obligation | Per regulation (5-7 years)

name: Complaint Handling Response and Retention Timeframe
description: Establishes a requirement for complaint handling based on contractual and legal obligations, citing an 8-week timeframe as per FCA requirements.
context: Complaint handling | Contractual & legal | 8 weeks (FCA requirement)

name: Financial Conduct Authority Requirements
description: The regulatory standards set by the Financial Conduct Authority that dictate the timeframe for complaint handling.

name: Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing
description: Financial crime risks addressed through KYC/AML compliance and associated legal obligations for data retention.

name: Fraud
description: The risk of fraudulent activity, mitigated through detection processes and a 3-year data retention period based on legitimate interest.

name: KYC/AML Compliance Monitoring
description: The operational process of ensuring KYC/AML compliance, which includes the legal obligation to retain data for 5-6 years post-closure.
context: KYC/AML compliance | Legal obligation | 5-6 years post-closure

name: Fraud Detection System
description: The mechanism used for fraud detection, supported by a specific data retention period of 3 years.

name: FirstUK Bank Data Collection Policy
description: A formal policy governing the types of data FirstUK Bank collects from its customers, categorized into identity, financial, behavioral, and device data.

name: Collection of Identity Data
description: Requirement to collect specific identity-related information including full name, date of birth, nationality, contact details, and identification documents.
context: Identity Data: Full name, date of birth, nationality

name: Collection of Financial Data
description: Requirement to collect financial information including account balances, transaction history, income/employment information, and credit information where applicable.
context: Financial Data: Account balances, transaction history

name: Collection of Behavioral Data for Fraud Detection
description: Requirement to collect behavioral data, specifically transaction patterns for the purpose of fraud detection, as well as product usage and interaction data.
context: Behavioral Data: Transaction patterns (for fraud detection)

name: Collection of Device Data
description: Requirement to collect technical device information including IP addresses, device types, location data for mobile app users, and device identifiers.
context: Device Data: IP address, device type

name: Fraud
description: The risk of fraudulent activity which necessitates the collection and analysis of customer transaction patterns.

name: Transaction Pattern Analysis
description: The use of behavioral data and transaction patterns as a mechanism to detect and mitigate fraud.

name: Identification Documents
description: Official documents collected as part of the identity data requirement to verify customer identity.

name: Bank Customer
description: The subject from whom identity, financial, behavioral, and device data is collected by the bank.

name: Customer Data Collection
description: The operational process of gathering customer information through various channels including direct input, verification documents, third-party sources, and automated system tracking.
context: Direct from customer (account forms, online signup)

name: Passport
description: An official identity document used as a verification document during the customer data collection process.

name: Utility Bill
description: A document used for verification purposes, typically to confirm a customer's address during data collection.

name: Customer
description: The individual providing information directly via account forms or online signup processes.
context: Direct from customer (account forms, online signup)

name: Third Parties
description: External entities, such as credit bureaus, from which the bank collects customer data specifically for mortgage applications.

name: Mortgage
description: A banking product for which data is collected from third-party credit bureaus.

name: FirstUK Bank Privacy Policy
description: The governing instrument defining the transparency requirements and the content of privacy notices provided to customers by FirstUK Bank.

name: Mandatory Provision of Privacy Notice at Account Opening
description: A mandatory requirement that a privacy notice must be provided to the customer during the account opening process.

name: Provision of Privacy Notice via Digital Channels
description: Requirement to provide the privacy notice during online or mobile app signup and via the public website.

name: Provision of Privacy Notice Upon Request
description: Requirement to provide the privacy notice to a customer whenever it is requested.

name: Mandatory Privacy Notice Content Standards
description: Specifies the mandatory information that must be included in the privacy notice, including controller identity, purposes, lawful basis, retention, rights, and contact details.

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The entity acting as the data controller responsible for the processing of data and the provision of the privacy notice.

name: Bank Customer
description: The subject of the privacy notice who is entitled to information regarding their data rights and the processing of their personal information.

name: New Account
description: An account in the process of being opened, which triggers the mandatory provision of a privacy notice.

name: Privacy Notice Disclosure
description: The operational mechanism of providing a formal notice to ensure transparency regarding data processing activities.

name: Data Subject Rights Policy
description: A policy governing the rights of data subjects under GDPR, specifically detailing the processes and obligations regarding the Right of Access to personal data.

name: Customer Right to Request Copy of Personal Data
description: A mandate allowing customers to request a copy of the personal data held by FirstUK Bank.
context: Customer Right: Request copy of personal data held

name: Right of Access Request Submission Process
description: Requirement that requests for personal data must be submitted as a written request to the designated privacy email address.

name: Identity Verification for Data Access
description: Obligation to perform identity verification for security purposes before granting access to personal data.

name: Data Access Response Timeframe
description: Mandatory response window of 30 days for standard requests, extendable to 60 days for complex cases.
context: Response within 30 days (or 60 days if complex)

name: Electronic Format Data Provision
description: Requirement that the requested personal data must be provided to the customer in an electronic format.

name: Fee Waiver for Data Access Requests
description: Provision stating that no fee is to be charged for data access requests, except in cases of excessive requests.

name: General Data Protection Regulation
description: The overarching European regulation on data protection and privacy that governs the bank's data subject rights processes.

name: Identity Verification Control
description: An operational safeguard used to verify the identity of the requester to ensure security before releasing personal data.

name: Data Subject
description: The individual (customer) who holds the right to request and receive a copy of their personal data.
context: Customer Right: Request copy of personal data held

name: Bank Customer
description: The customer of FirstUK Bank who is the subject of the data access rights.
context: Customer Right: Request copy of personal data held

name: Right to Erasure Policy
description: A policy governing the 'Right to Erasure' (Right to be Forgotten), defining the conditions under which customer data must be deleted and the specific exceptions where data retention is mandated.
context: Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten")

name: Conditions for Data Erasure
description: Mandates the erasure of data when it is no longer necessary for its original purpose, there is no legal obligation to retain it, no legitimate interest exists, or the customer withdraws consent.
context: Data no longer necessary for purpose

name: Exceptions to Right to Erasure
description: Prohibits the erasure of data, despite a request, in cases of legal/regulatory obligations, ongoing disputes, fraud investigations, pending financial claims, or active accounts.

name: Anti-Money Laundering Regulations
description: Regulatory requirements regarding Anti-Money Laundering that create a legal obligation for the bank to retain records, overriding erasure requests.

name: Know Your Customer Regulations
description: Regulatory requirements regarding Know Your Customer records that necessitate data retention regardless of erasure requests.

name: Fraud
description: The risk of fraudulent activity, the investigation of which serves as a valid exception to the right to erasure.

name: Customer
description: The individual who holds the right to request the erasure of their data or withdraw consent for data processing.

name: Customer
description: The bank customer who may exercise the Right to be Forgotten.

name: Active Account
description: An account that is currently open and active, which serves as a condition for retaining customer data despite an erasure request.

name: Active Product
description: A banking product currently held by a customer, which justifies the continued retention of associated data.

name: Right to Rectification Policy
description: A policy governing the process by which customers can correct inaccurate data held by FirstUK Bank, including verification and notification requirements.

name: Customer
description: The individual who holds the right to request the correction of inaccurate data held by the bank.

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The entity responsible for verifying correction requests, updating systems, and notifying third parties.

name: Customer Right to Correct Inaccurate Data
description: A provision granting customers the right to request the correction of inaccurate data held by the bank.

name: Verification of Data Correction Requests
description: A requirement that FirstUK Bank must verify any requested change to customer data before it is implemented.

name: Data Update Timeframe
description: A mandatory requirement to update bank systems within 30 days following a correction request.

name: Third Party Notification Obligation
description: An obligation to notify third parties of data corrections if the inaccurate data had previously been shared with them.
context: Notify third parties if data shared

name: Correction Request Submission Process
description: The operational mechanism allowing customers to submit requests for data correction.

name: Right to Restrict Processing Policy
description: A policy governing the customer's right to limit the way their data is used without requiring full deletion. It defines the scenarios under which data processing is restricted and the conditions for limited processing.
context: Customer Right: Limit how data used (but not require deletion)

name: Obligation to Limit Data Usage upon Customer Request
description: A requirement to limit how customer data is used when a customer exercises their right to restrict processing, specifically noting that this does not necessitate the deletion of the data.
context: Customer Right: Limit how data used (but not require deletion)

name: Restriction of Processing During Accuracy Disputes
description: A mandate to restrict the processing of data in scenarios where a customer disputes the accuracy of the information.
context: Data processing while accuracy under dispute

name: Permitted Processing for Legal Obligations
description: A provision stating that even when data is restricted, limited processing is permitted if it is required to meet legal obligations.
context: Limited processing only for legal obligations

name: Systemic Data Restriction Marking
description: An operational safeguard where data is explicitly marked as 'restricted' within the bank's systems to prevent unauthorized processing during a dispute.

name: Customer
description: The individual who holds the right to request the restriction of their data processing and may dispute the accuracy of their records.
context: Customer Right: Limit how data used

name: Customer
description: The bank customer who is the subject of the data restriction rights.
context: Customer Right: Limit how data used

name: Right to Data Portability Policy
description: A policy governing the customer's right to obtain their personal data in a portable format for transfer to another service provider.

name: Customer Right to Data Portability
description: Mandates that customers must be allowed to obtain their data in a portable format specifically for the purpose of transferring it to another provider.
context: Customer Right: Obtain data in portable format for transfer to another provider

name: Data Portability Request Process
description: Requires that the process for data portability be initiated via a written request from the customer that specifies the data required.

name: Data Portability Format Standard
description: Obligates the bank to provide the requested data in a common electronic format, specifically citing CSV or JSON.
context: Data provided in common electronic format (CSV, JSON)

name: Data Portability Response Timeframe
description: Sets a mandatory deadline for the bank to respond to a data portability request within 30 days.

name: Scope of Portable Data
description: Defines the scope of data subject to portability as data provided by the customer or data generated through the customer's use of the service.
context: Applies to data provided by customer or generated through use

name: Electronic Data Export
description: The technical mechanism of providing data in common electronic formats such as CSV and JSON to ensure portability.
context: Data provided in common electronic format (CSV, JSON)

name: Customer
description: The individual who holds the right to request their data in a portable format and is responsible for submitting a written request specifying the data.
context: Customer Right: Obtain data in portable format
Applies to data provided by customer

name: Data Portability Customer
description: A bank customer exercising their right to data portability.
context: Customer Right: Obtain data in portable format for transfer to another provider

name: Right to Object Policy
description: A policy governing the rights of customers to object to the processing of their data, specifically regarding direct marketing, profiling, and legitimate interest processing.

name: Mandatory Direct Marketing Opt-Out
description: A mandatory requirement ensuring that customers have the right to opt out of direct marketing processing.

name: Right to Object to Profiling and Automated Decisions
description: A provision allowing customers to object to data processing used for profiling or automated decision-making.

name: Right to Object to Legitimate Interest Processing
description: A provision allowing customers to object to processing based on legitimate interests, provided there is no compelling reason to continue.
context: Legitimate interest processing: Can object if no compelling reason

name: Immediate Recording of Marketing Preferences
description: A requirement that customer marketing preferences must be recorded in the system immediately upon request.

name: Email Marketing Opt-Out Link
description: An operational mechanism requiring a preference link to be included in every marketing email to facilitate customer opt-outs.
context: Email preference: link in every marketing email

name: Phone Preference Support Request
description: A process where customers can manage their phone marketing preferences by submitting a request to the support team.
context: Phone preference: request to support team

name: SMS STOP Keyword Mechanism
description: A technical control allowing customers to opt out of SMS marketing by texting 'STOP' to a designated number.

name: Support Team
description: The staff collective responsible for handling and processing customer requests regarding phone marketing preferences.
context: Phone preference: request to support team

name: Customer
description: The subject of the policy who holds the right to object to various forms of data processing and marketing.

name: Right to Not Be Subject to Automated Decisions Policy
description: A policy governing the protections afforded to customers regarding high-impact automated decisions, ensuring that such decisions are subject to human oversight and appeal processes.
context: Right to Not Be Subject to Automated Decisions
Protection: High-impact automated decisions require human review

name: Requirement for Human Review of High-Impact Automated Decisions
description: Mandates that any automated decision classified as high-impact must be subject to review by a human operator.
context: High-impact automated decisions require human review

name: Right to be Informed of Automated Decisions
description: Establishes the right of the subject to be notified when an automated decision has been made regarding them.

name: Right to Request Human Review
description: Grants the subject the right to request that a human review the outcome of an automated decision.

name: Right to Provide Perspective on Automated Decisions
description: Ensures the subject has the opportunity to provide their own perspective or additional information regarding an automated decision.

name: Right to Appeal Automated Decisions
description: Provides a formal mechanism for the subject to appeal a decision reached through automated processing.

name: Automated Lending Risk
description: The risk associated with automated lending decisions, specifically the potential for unfair or incorrect mortgage application rejections.

name: Automated Fraud Detection Risk
description: The risk associated with automated fraud detection systems resulting in erroneous account freezes.

name: Automated Credit Scoring Risk
description: The risk associated with the use of automated systems to determine credit scores.

name: Human Review Process
description: An operational safeguard requiring a human to review high-impact automated decisions to prevent errors or unfair outcomes.
context: High-impact automated decisions require human review

name: Data Subject
description: The individual who is the subject of an automated decision and holds the rights to be informed, request review, provide perspective, and appeal.

name: Frozen Account
description: An account that has been frozen as a result of an automated fraud detection decision.

name: Data Security Policy
description: A formal policy governing the security of data within FirstUK Bank, specifically detailing the encryption standards for data both in transit and at rest.

name: Mandatory TLS 1.3 for Data Transmission
description: Requirement that all data transmission across web and mobile platforms must utilize TLS 1.3.
context: TLS 1.3 for all data transmission (web, mobile)

name: Enforcement of HTTPS on Customer-Facing Systems
description: Mandate that HTTPS must be enforced on all systems that are customer-facing.
context: HTTPS enforced on all customer-facing systems

name: Mandatory VPN for Staff Remote Access
description: Requirement for staff to use a Virtual Private Network (VPN) when accessing bank systems remotely.

name: Mandatory AES-256 Encryption for Databases
description: Requirement that all databases must be encrypted using the AES-256 standard.

name: Mandatory Encryption of Backups
description: Requirement that all backups, including those stored in S3 and off-site, must be encrypted.

name: Mandatory Encryption of File Storage
description: Requirement that all file storage must be encrypted.

name: Mandatory Encryption of Portable Devices
description: Requirement that all USB and portable devices must be encrypted.

name: TLS 1.3
description: Technical encryption protocol used to secure data transmission for web and mobile channels.
context: TLS 1.3 for all data transmission (web, mobile)

name: HTTPS
description: Secure communication protocol enforced on all customer-facing systems.
context: HTTPS enforced on all customer-facing systems

name: VPN
description: Secure tunnel used to provide staff with remote access to the bank's internal network.

name: AES-256
description: Advanced Encryption Standard with a 256-bit key used to secure databases at rest.

name: Information Security Risk
description: The risk of unauthorized access or data breach, mitigated through the application of encryption standards for data in transit and at rest.

name: Access Control Policy
description: A policy governing the management of data access within the bank, defining role-based access levels and authentication requirements to ensure data security and regulatory compliance.

name: Role-Based Access Limitation for Customer-facing Staff
description: Mandates that customer-facing staff must have their access limited strictly to the customer data necessary for providing service.
context: Customer-facing staff: Limited to customer data needed for service

name: Full Data Access for Compliance Staff
description: Grants compliance staff full access to data for the purpose of meeting regulatory requirements.
context: Compliance staff: Full data access for regulatory purposes

name: Database Access and Audit Logging for Technology Staff
description: Permits technology staff to have database access, provided that such access is subject to audit logging.
context: Technology staff: Database access (with audit logging)

name: Aggregated Data Access Restriction for Executives
description: Restricts executives to aggregated data only, prohibiting access to individual personal details.
context: Executives: Aggregated data only (no personal details)

name: Multi-factor Authentication for Privileged Access
description: Requires the use of multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all administrative and compliance-level access.

name: Mandatory Audit Logging of All Access
description: Requires that all instances of system access be recorded via audit logging.

name: Multi-factor Authentication
description: A technical security control requiring multiple forms of verification, specifically username/password combined with a One-Time Password (OTP).

name: Audit Logging
description: An operational mechanism used to track and record access to databases and general system access for accountability.

name: Customer-facing Staff
description: Staff members interacting with customers whose data access is limited to service-essential information.
context: Customer-facing staff: Limited to customer data needed for service

name: Compliance Staff
description: Staff responsible for regulatory oversight who are granted full data access for compliance purposes.
context: Compliance staff: Full data access for regulatory purposes

name: Technology Staff
description: Staff managing the bank's technical infrastructure with authorized access to databases subject to logging.
context: Technology staff: Database access (with audit logging)

name: Executives
description: Senior leadership restricted to viewing aggregated data without access to personal details.
context: Executives: Aggregated data only (no personal details)

name: Data Breach Response Policy
description: A formal policy governing the bank's response to data breaches, including notification requirements for individuals and regulatory bodies, and internal escalation procedures.

name: General Data Protection Regulation
description: The overarching regulatory framework that mandates notification requirements when a data breach is likely to cause high risk to individuals.

name: Information Commissioner's Office
description: The regulatory authority to which the bank must provide notification in the event of a data breach if required.

name: Data Breach
description: The risk of unauthorized access or disclosure of data which may cause high risk to individuals and necessitate regulatory notification.
context: If breach likely to cause high risk to individuals
Breach identified → Escalate to Data Protection Officer

name: Data Protection Officer
description: The role responsible for receiving escalations of identified breaches and overseeing the subsequent investigation and notification decisions.

name: Mandatory Individual Notification for High Risk Breaches
description: Requirement to notify affected individuals within 72 hours if a breach is likely to cause high risk, including details on the event, data involved, mitigation, and contact info.
context: If breach likely to cause high risk to individuals
Notification includes: What happened, what data, mitigation steps, contact for questions

name: Internal Breach Escalation and Investigation Timeline
description: Mandate that identified breaches must be escalated to the Data Protection Officer and an investigation must be initiated within 24 hours.
context: Breach identified → Escalate to Data Protection Officer

name: Breach Risk Assessment and Notification Decision
description: Requirement to perform a risk level assessment following a breach to determine the necessity of notification decisions and regulatory reporting.

name: Internal Escalation Process
description: The operational mechanism of escalating identified breaches to the Data Protection Officer to trigger the response workflow.
context: Breach identified → Escalate to Data Protection Officer

name: Cookies & Web Tracking Policy
description: A policy governing the use of cookies and web tracking technologies at FirstUK Bank, distinguishing between essential and optional cookies and their respective consent requirements.

name: Consent Exemption for Essential Cookies
description: A provision stating that essential cookies, including those for session management, security, and performance, do not require user consent for deployment.

name: Mandatory Consent for Optional Cookies
description: A provision requiring explicit user consent before the deployment of optional cookies used for analytics and marketing purposes.

name: Session Cookies
description: Technical cookies used to maintain user login sessions.

name: Security Cookies
description: Technical cookies implemented specifically for the purpose of fraud prevention.

name: Performance Cookies
description: Technical cookies used for the tracking and logging of system errors.

name: Analytics Cookies
description: Optional cookies used to track and analyze user behavior on the bank's web platforms.

name: Marketing Cookies
description: Optional cookies used for the delivery of personalized advertisements and retargeting efforts.

name: Fraud
description: The risk of fraudulent activity which is mitigated through the use of security cookies.

name: Cookie Management Policy
description: A policy governing the management of cookies on the bank's website, focusing on customer choice, consent mechanisms, and the use of third-party analytics.

name: Provision of Cookie Consent Banner
description: Requirement to provide a cookie banner on the website to facilitate customer choice regarding cookie usage.

name: Option to Reject Non-Essential Cookies
description: Requirement to provide customers with the explicit option to either accept or reject non-essential cookies.

name: Provision of Cookie Preference Center
description: Requirement to maintain a preference center for the ongoing management of cookie settings.

name: Right to Withdraw Cookie Consent
description: Obligation to ensure customers have the ability to withdraw their previously given consent for cookies at any time.

name: Third-Party Analytics IP Anonymization
description: Requirement that IP anonymization must be enabled within the privacy settings for third-party analytics tools.

name: Analytics Data Retention Period
description: Mandate that data collected via third-party analytics is retained for a period of 14 months.

name: Cookie Preference Center
description: A technical tool provided to customers to manage and modify their cookie preferences.

name: IP Anonymization
description: A technical privacy setting used to anonymize IP addresses for third-party analytics to protect user identity.

name: Customer
description: The individual interacting with the website who holds the right to accept, reject, or withdraw consent for cookies.

name: Google Analytics
description: An anonymized third-party analytics tool used by the bank to monitor website usage.

name: Third-Party Data Processing Policy
description: A policy governing the engagement and management of third-party data processors who handle bank data on its behalf, ensuring compliance with data protection standards.

name: Requirement for Data Processing Agreements with Processors
description: A mandatory requirement that a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) must be established with each third-party processor handling bank data.
context: Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with each processor

name: Requirement for GDPR-Compliant Terms
description: A requirement that all terms governing data processing by third parties must be compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

name: Subprocessor Notification Requirement

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: A contractual safeguard required before sharing data with third-party service providers.

name: Customer Profile Retention Requirement
description: Mandates that customer profile data must be retained for the duration of the account tenure plus an additional 6 years, based on POCA and anti-fraud requirements.
context: Customer profile | Account tenure + 6 years | POCA, anti-fraud

name: Transaction Records Retention Requirement
description: Requires that transaction records be kept for a minimum period of 6 years for regulatory and dispute purposes.
context: Transaction records | 6 years minimum | Regulatory, dispute

name: KYC/AML Records Retention Requirement
description: Mandates the retention of KYC and AML records for a period of 5 to 6 years following the closure of the account, in accordance with AML regulations.
context: KYC/AML records | 5-6 years post-closure | AML regulations

name: Complaint Records Retention Requirement
description: Requires that records of complaints be retained for a minimum of 6 years for regulatory compliance.

name: Marketing Consent Retention Requirement
description: Specifies that marketing consent data must be retained until the consent is withdrawn, based on GDPR consent rules.
context: Marketing consent | Until withdrawal | GDPR consent

name: Website Cookies Retention Requirement
description: Defines the retention of website cookies as the session duration, with an extension to 14 months for analytics, based on cookie consent.
context: Website cookies | Session (+ 14 months analytics) | Cookie consent

name: Proceeds of Crime Act

name: General Data Protection Regulation

name: Fraud
description: The risk of fraudulent activity, which serves as a basis for the extended retention of customer profile data.

name: Record Keeping
description: The operational mechanism of maintaining data retention schedules to ensure regulatory compliance across various data types.

name: International Data Transfers Policy
description: A policy governing the transfer of data across international borders, specifically defining the current scope of transfers and the requirements for future transfers to non-EEA jurisdictions.

name: Requirement for Standard Contractual Clauses for Non-EEA Transfers
description: Mandates that any future data transfers to jurisdictions outside the European Economic Area (Non-EEA) must utilize Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC).

name: Requirement for UK Government Adequacy Decision
description: Requires that transfers to non-EEA jurisdictions be supported by an adequacy decision issued by the UK government.

name: Requirement for Supplementary Safeguards Assessment
description: Obligates the bank to assess supplementary safeguards when conducting data transfers to non-EEA jurisdictions.

name: Standard Contractual Clauses
description: Standardized contractual terms used to ensure appropriate data protection safeguards for transfers of personal data to third countries.

name: UK Government
description: The governmental authority responsible for issuing adequacy decisions regarding the data protection standards of non-EEA countries.

name: Supplementary Safeguards Assessment
description: The operational process of assessing additional security or legal safeguards to protect data during non-EEA transfers.

name: Data Protection Officer
description: The individual responsible for the oversight of the privacy policy, monitoring GDPR compliance, and managing data breach investigations. This role also handles subject access requests, staff training, and serves as the primary liaison with regulatory bodies.

name: Privacy Policy
description: The formal governing instrument regarding data privacy, the oversight of which is assigned to the Data Protection Officer.

name: Data Breach
description: A risk event involving the unauthorized access or disclosure of data, requiring investigation by the Data Protection Officer.

name: Obligation to Process Subject Access Requests
description: A requirement that subject access requests must be processed, with the responsibility assigned to the Data Protection Officer.

name: Obligation to Provide Staff Training on Data Protection
description: A mandate for the delivery of staff training regarding data protection and privacy, managed by the Data Protection Officer.

name: GDPR Compliance Monitoring
description: The operational mechanism of monitoring the bank's adherence to GDPR requirements, performed by the Data Protection Officer.

name: Data Processors (Staff)
description: Staff members acting as data processors who are responsible for the secure handling of customer data, breach reporting, and adherence to security and privacy procedures.

name: Secure Handling of Customer Data
description: A mandatory requirement for Data Processors (Staff) to ensure that all customer data is handled securely.

name: Immediate Breach Reporting
description: An obligation for Data Processors (Staff) to report data breaches immediately upon discovery.

name: Respect for Customer Privacy
description: A requirement for Data Processors (Staff) to respect the privacy of the bank's customers.

name: Adherence to Security Procedures
description: A mandate requiring Data Processors (Staff) to follow established security procedures.

name: Mandatory Security Training Completion
description: A requirement for Data Processors (Staff) to complete necessary training.

name: Security Procedures
description: The defined security procedures that staff must follow to ensure the protection of data.

name: Staff Training
description: The training program that staff are required to complete to ensure compliance with data handling and security policies.

name: Data Breach
description: The risk of unauthorized access or disclosure of customer data, which triggers an immediate reporting obligation.

name: Data Controller
description: The entity responsible for determining the purposes of data processing and ensuring the implementation of GDPR safeguards. This role is tasked with processing customer requests, maintaining privacy notices, and notifying authorities in the event of a data breach.

name: General Data Protection Regulation
description: The regulatory framework governing data protection and privacy, the safeguards of which must be implemented by the Data Controller.

name: Obligation to Determine Processing Purposes
description: A mandatory requirement for the Data Controller to define and determine the specific purposes for which data is processed.

name: Obligation to Implement GDPR Safeguards
description: A requirement for the Data Controller to put in place the necessary safeguards as mandated by the GDPR.

name: Obligation to Process Customer Requests
description: A requirement for the Data Controller to handle and process requests submitted by customers regarding their data.

name: Obligation to Maintain Privacy Notices
description: A requirement for the Data Controller to ensure that privacy notices are kept up to date and maintained.

name: Obligation to Notify Authorities of Data Breaches
description: A mandatory requirement for the Data Controller to notify the relevant authorities if a data breach occurs.

name: Data Breach
description: The risk of unauthorized access or disclosure of data, which triggers a mandatory notification obligation to authorities.

name: Subject Access Request (SAR) Process
description: A formal process governing how FirstUK Bank handles requests from customers to obtain copies of their personal data. It defines the submission channels, verification steps, compilation requirements, and response timelines.
context: Customer Right: Obtain copy of personal data

name: Customer Right to Personal Data Access
description: The bank must allow customers to obtain a copy of their personal data upon request.
context: Customer Right: Obtain copy of personal data

name: Customer Identity Verification for SAR
description: FirstUK Bank is required to verify the identity of the customer making a SAR and may request additional identification to ensure security and prevent fraud.

name: Data Compilation and Third-Party Redaction
description: The bank must collect data from all systems and ensure that third-party personal data is removed or redacted before providing the information to the customer.

name: SAR Response Timeframe
description: Data must be provided to the customer within 30 days, with a possible extension of 2 months for requests deemed complex.
context: May extend 2 months for complex requests

name: Mandatory Redaction of Privileged and Confidential Information
description: The bank must redact legal professional privilege, third-party confidential data, and trade secrets from the provided data.

name: Fraud
description: The risk of fraudulent requests for personal data, mitigated by identity verification and security checks during the SAR process.

name: Identity Verification Check
description: The operational process of verifying a customer's identity and requesting additional identification to prevent unauthorized data disclosure.

name: Data Redaction
description: The process of removing or masking third-party data, legal privilege, and trade secrets from the compiled SAR response.

name: Customer
description: The individual who holds the right to request and obtain a copy of their personal data from the bank.
context: Customer Right: Obtain copy of personal data

name: SAR Requesting Customer

context: Customer Right: Obtain copy of personal data

name: Data Breach

name: Data Protection Controls
